how_to_check: Each report lists hashed_fields exactly as they were hashed. Serialize hashed_fields with RFC 8785 (JCS) and take its SHA-256: that is content_hash. Then chain_hash = SHA256(content_hash + prev_chain_hash). Every logbook is its own chain. Its first report links to SHA256("reportlog-chain:" + the logbook's slug), not to zeros.
notes: Published reports only. A report withdrawn after a snapshot was published stops appearing in later snapshots; it is not removed from earlier ones, which are already public. chains covers every report in each logbook, including any not published here. The daily anchor is what ties it to an outside timestamp. Contact details are not part of the fingerprint and are not in this file.
